title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1982-08-04
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. July 2016
source: AUD: Unknown mics > lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell UDXLII 90s. Recording by Jon Bernstein.

ai_review.summary: High‑energy, sweaty show captured on a low‑fidelity audience tape
ai_review.review: The crowd was on fire and the performance is described as "smoked" and "super sweaty," making it a memorable night for those who waited decades. However, the recording quality is poor – likely an audience taping that sounds muddy and lacks clarity – which limits its listenability.

ai_rating.rationale: Review praises the performance strongly but rates it only 3 stars due to very poor recording quality; with one detailed review, confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is not great; typical of this venue’s tapers – muddy and lacking clarity, making the tape hard to follow.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy set that kept heads boogying throughout; no specific flow comments provided.
